page.layout: One page of running text in a single column. One marginal note in the right margin, beside the lines of the second half of the column. Running head at top. Gathering signature at bottom left and catchword at bottom right, below the last line.

main_text.p: cum illustri Gubernatore D. GUILHEL-MO LUDOVICO Comite Nassavio controversiam inter partes componerent amicè: si non possent, statuerent pro tempore, quod quieti & regimini expedire videretur, tantisper donec pleniore judicio cognitâ causâ omnia definirentur. Ii, adhibita summa diligentia & studio cum gubernatore, cum[?] frustrà diu in compositione controversiæ universæ laborassent tandem ea, quæ ad formam & ordinem politiæ provincialis in hac conjunctione cum Ordinibus fœderatis, & ad pecuniæ communis administrationem faciebant, accepta in id plena à partibus potestate, primum constituerunt. In his sciverunt ante omnia, ut civitas & ager una sint pro-Decretum III.viro-rū ab Or-dinibus ge-neralibus delegato-rum.vincia in perpetuum sub uno Guberna-tore: ut conventus provinciæ communes sint utrique parti, habeanturque non alibi quam Groninga. In primis collegium novum instituerunt ad modum cæteris in provinciis fœderatis usitatum, in quod quatuor viros oppidani, totidem agrarii darent, conjunctionis atque unitatis vinculum & nervum: ejus collegij munus esset curare & admi-
Decretum III.viro-rū ab Ordinibus generalibus delegatorum.

page.notes: The first line runs on from the previous page, so the first paragraph is marked as a continuation. The small-caps name GUILHEL-MO LUDOVICO is set in capitals with the vowel u written as U. The printed line "illustriGubernatoreD." has no spaces in the original type; I have added them. "uno .Guberna-" has a stray full stop in print; I have left it out. "cum" on the eighth line is uncertain, so it is marked [?]. The marginal note is one block beside the lines 16 to 19 and is written out in full. Italic runs from "ut civitas" to the end of the page.
